title: Rig and Frac Crew of the Quarter Winners (2Q 2026)
body_markdown:
Each quarter, the HSER and Operations teams recognize rig and frac crews that stand out for their safety results and industry-leading operational performance — a chance to spotlight the great work happening in the field and celebrate the people behind Expand Energy’s success.


This quarter’s honorees reflect what sets our crews apart: a genuine commitment to safety, teamwork and operational excellence day in and day out.


**Workover Rig of the Quarter – Key 6123**
**Haynesville**


Key 6123 earned Workover Rig of the Quarter for its exceptional safety leadership, achieving zero velocity incidents, zero recordables and zero SIF events throughout the second quarter.


*“This crew’s commitment to proactive safety culture is evident through consistent Good Catch participation and earning a Good Catch Winner recognition in April — showing they actively identify and address hazards before incidents occur,” said Cody McCormick, Workover Manager.*


---


**Drilling Rig of the Quarter** – ****Patterson 583****
**App – Pennsylvania**


Patterson 583 earned Drilling Rig of the Quarter after delivering a perfect safety record in the quarter: zero recordables, velocity incidents, SIF actuals and SIFp events. On the operational front, the crew achieved this safety performance while also exceeding drilling performance targets.


*“Safety and performance go hand in hand, and Patterson 583 proved it. Zero incidents, zero recordables, and drilling targets exceeded every single month — that’s how you earn Rig of the Quarter,” said Josh Williams, Sr. HSE Manager.*


---


****Frac Crew of the Quarter – **NexTier 29******
****App – Pennsylvania****


NexTier 29 consistently delivered exceptional operational performance — combining reliable execution, strong teamwork and a relentless focus on efficiency — to earn Frac Crew of the Quarter.


*“This crew’s unwavering commitment to safety, as demonstrated by proactive hazard recognition, risk mitigation and disciplined adherence to procedures, helped create a safe work environment to support their outstanding operational results,” said Harris Marcom, HSE Manager.*
